farmer_guide_modal_intro: Follow these steps to submit your farmer application and start selling with verified trust.
farmer_guide_step_1: Fill the farmer application form with your name, email, and phone number.
farmer_guide_step_2: Upload your organic farm document, and add the FSSAI certificate if you sell packaged products.
farmer_guide_step_3: Submit the application and wait for review and verification.
farmer_guide_step_4: After verification, list your products and begin selling to customers.
user_guide_modal_intro: Use these steps to check authenticity before buying from any farmer profile.
user_guide_step_1: Open the farmer profile and look for the verified badge.
user_guide_step_2: Review the farmer profile details and product listings.
user_guide_step_3: Check the organic certificate and other certifications shown on the profile.
user_guide_step_4: Read ratings and reviews from other customers.
user_guide_step_5: Add the product to cart and place your order only after verifying authenticity.
